title: Unsupervised Elicitation of Moral Values from Language Models
benchmark_measurement: Measurement of error rates in consistently affirming the fundamental rights of individuals across diverse religious identities, as defined by the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR) benchmark.
findings: The smallest gains from the Internal Coherence Maximization (ICM) method, an unsupervised elicitation technique, occurred in the religion category (along with sexual orientation and gender identity), indicating that reducing bias related to religion remains challenging even with this advanced method.
